# PromptMap Seed Library

This directory contains optional third-party security testing prompt templates copied from the upstream PromptMap project for authorized testing only.

- Upstream repository: https://github.com/utkusen/promptmap
- Upstream license: GPL-3.0
- Integration model: optional seed corpus only; these files are not loaded by agentOwl V1 by default.
- Provenance: each YAML file includes `source_repository`, `source_file`, `source_ref`, `original_license`, and `modified_by_agentowl` metadata.

## License note

These copied templates originate from PromptMap and remain subject to the upstream GPL-3.0 terms. The main agentOwl project is MIT-licensed; this directory is intentionally separated to make third-party provenance and licensing explicit.

If a copied template is modified locally, set `modified_by_agentowl: true` and document the change in `modification_note`.
